status: READ_ONLY_SCHEMA -- not a global reasoning graph
scope_note: This schema describes ONLY the 4-node network built from validated REFERENCE_LANDMARK_SUPPORTED landmarks. It is explicitly not, and must not be extended into, a general-purpose 'reasoning graph' for the model.

fields.epistemic_status: REFERENCE_LANDMARK_SUPPORTED (all 4, by construction of the frozen node set)

Edges.cardinality: up to 12 (4x3 ordered pairs); this gate observed 12/12 with >=1 supporting run, 0/12 statistically VALIDATED after Bonferroni correction

fields.validation_status: VALIDATED | LOW_SUPPORT | NOT_SUPPORTED, from EDGE_VALIDATION_RESULTS.json's frozen permutation test

RouteInstances.source: ROUTE_INSTANCES.csv, one row per raw run (18 with >=1 landmark, 12 with none)

fields.route_signature: collapsed (consecutive-duplicate-merged, co-occurrence-tied) signature string used for ROUTE_SIGNATURES.json clustering
fields.landmarks_bypassed: comma-separated node_ids never encountered in this run

explicit_non_claims: No node or edge means: reasoning step, cognitive stage, decision, concept, truth state, hallucination state, causal mechanism.
No global model-wide graph is implied or constructed -- this schema covers only the 4 validated nodes and their observed inter-relationships in this specific 21-run eligible pool.
